failure_modes.name: tb65_battery_cycle_fade
failure_modes.symptoms: reduced endurance; cell imbalance; longer charge time; capacity below 85%
failure_modes.mitigation: retire at ~400 cycles; cool storage; balance charge; avoid deep discharge

failure_modes.name: gimbal_connector_fault
failure_modes.symptoms: camera feed dropout; gimbal not recognized; intermittent payload error; loose seat
failure_modes.mitigation: inspect connector pins; correct mating torque; protective cap when idle; payload re-init on fault

failure_modes.name: o3_link_interference
failure_modes.symptoms: video stutter; control-latency spikes; link-lost warning; reduced range near structures
failure_modes.mitigation: add redundant LTE/4G dongle; pre-flight frequency scan; avoid RF-dense corridors; antenna orientation check

failure_modes.name: ip55_seal_aging
failure_modes.symptoms: moisture inside body; fogged internals; connector corrosion; visible seal cracking
failure_modes.mitigation: annual seal replacement; post-rain inspection; silica desiccant packs; pressure test

failure_modes.name: propeller_stress
failure_modes.symptoms: crack at prop root; vibration increase; unusual acoustic tone; imbalance warning
failure_modes.mitigation: root crack inspection each flight; replace at ~300 cycles; avoid ground strike; torque prop nuts
